data.description: Render slop/BRANDING.md into slop/index.html using the brand-page skill (procedure at .claude/skills/brand-page/SKILL.md — read it in full; it is the authoritative workflow). Human invoked /brand-page on 2026-08-08 immediately after FA-14 landed the brief (commits 1d7cd4e, c967aaf). Scope: slop/index.html only (self-contained inline style/script, standalone page). The brief's §11 'Page application' describes the target page concretely and §11 'Build-contract constraints' restates the sub-site authoring contract — both must be honored, along with the brief's every-word law, gold-ramp recipe, garble lexicon, SVG clip-art data URIs, raster degradation rule (the three /slop/*.png images do NOT exist yet — the gradient stand-ins must carry the page), and own scroll container. Per the skill: do NOT commit (leave in working tree), do NOT touch root index.html/style.css/script.js, no external requests except the brief's named Google Fonts import. Out of scope: sites.config.json mapping, node build.js, generating raster images.
data.title: Generate slop/index.html from BRANDING.md via brand-page skill

data.body: Built slop/index.html (single self-contained file, no JS) per plan: full flier composition — raster-slot stands-ins, gold-ramp ALMASI + 15ND, lexicon garble, sacred links plate, 3 keyframes + reduced-motion. Verified headless: no hscroll at 320, blink rests visible under reduced motion. Screenshots: scratchpad slop-390.png / slop-1280.png / slop-320-full.png / slop-320-rrm.png

REVIEW (cold, against plan + BRANDING.md §11): PASS with minor inline fixes. Verified statically and in headless Chrome (1280x900 direct; 320px and 390px via same-origin iframe harness; computed-style probes; --force-prefers-reduced-motion run). §11 'The test': all six fonts load (document.fonts probe); no adjacent display words share font/size/angle/treatment (banner row shares Bungee Shade across SOFTWARE/TAKE/OVER but §11 specs that row in one face; sizes 5.6/7.84/4.48cqi + pink TAKE differentiate); no row at 0deg; 15ND wears wrong ordinal; every gold element's computed background-image is a gradient, zero flat gold (crown gold is SVG-internal gradient); 5 clip-art marks + splatter visible, peace clipped by canvas edge (rect probe), crown overlaps ALMASI text (rect-intersection probe); page composes with all three /slop/*.png absent (they don't exist - every render exercised the degradation path); links block spelled correctly (@malls, @forrestalmasi, _@forrestalmasi.com), sticker chips on solid --void plate, all effective tilts <=1.5deg, clickable at 320px; .slop-scroll owns scroll (scrollHeight 626 > clientHeight 480 while document does not overflow); no horizontal scroll at 320 (scrollWidth==clientWidth); reduced-motion: FREE rests visible, animations collapse to one 0.01ms run. Contract: @import first rule with %3B intact, only allowed at-rules, sole id is slop-crown-au inside crown data URI, keyframes slop-prefixed (exactly 3), no :is/:where, no literal </style> in CSS, zero script tags, html unstyled, no display on body, no position:fixed, raster URLs absolute in scrim/PNG/stand-in stacks. Garble audit: every string verbatim from §6 lexicon/moves, nothing invented; name/links straight. INLINE FIXES (uncommitted, 6 tokens): (1) tilt sign alternation per §3/§8 - date tilt-2->tilt-4, time tilt-4->tilt-5, crew tilt-5->tilt-4, giving -6,+3.5,-2,+5,-3.5,+5,-6,+3.5,-2 (plan's own tilt assignments made strict alternation impossible; brief outranks plan); (2) .slop-pullup -1deg->-0.6deg - nested rotations compounded GitHub chip to -1.8deg, outside sacred +-1.5deg (now -1.4/-0.1/-1.1... totals -1.4,+0.1,-1.1); (3) crown left 56cqi->52cqi - bounding box stopped exactly at ALMASI's right edge, no text overlap (acceptance #4). Deviation accepted: banner base 5.6cqi vs §11's t-mid=7cqi (TAKE at 1.4em=7.84cqi lands t-mid scale; needed for per-word size variance). Nothing committed; slop/index.html remains untracked as mandated. Screenshots: scratchpad/review-1280.png, review-320.png, review-390.png.
